units.en: Having left home for a thousand li to seek a small salary, the local chief handles affairs—why worry about incapacity? Moreover, honoring good and advancing the worthy—the matter is not here."
units.literal: Having left home for a thousand li to seek a small salary, the local chief handles affairs—why worry about incapacity? Moreover, honoring good and advancing the worthy—the matter is not here.'

units.zh: 故其年註擬，無退量者。
units.en: Therefore in that year's appointments, none were rejected for insufficient qualifications.
units.literal: Therefore in that year's appointments, none were rejected for insufficient measure.

units.zh: 及渾瑊與吐蕃會盟之日，上御便殿謂宰相曰：「和戎息師，國之大計，今日將士與卿同歡。」
units.en: On the day when Hun Zhen allied with Tibet, the emperor attended the informal hall and told the chief ministers, "Making peace with the barbarians and resting the armies is a great plan of state. Today soldiers and ministers rejoice together with you."
units.literal: On the day when Hun Zhen allied with Tibet, the emperor attended the informal hall and told the chief ministers: 'Making peace with the barbarians and resting the armies is a great plan of state—today soldiers and ministers rejoice together with you.'

units.zh: 馬燧前賀曰：今之一盟，百年內更無蕃寇。」
units.en: Ma Sui stepped forward in congratulation, saying, "With this one alliance, within a hundred years there will be no more Tibetan raids."
units.literal: Ma Sui stepped forward in congratulation, saying: 'With this one alliance, within a hundred years there will be no more Tibetan raids.'

units.zh: 渾曰：「五帝無誥誓之盟，皆在季末。
units.en: Hun said, "The Five Emperors had no alliances of proclamation and oath. All such came at the end of ages.
units.literal: Hun said: 'The Five Emperors had no alliances of proclamation and oath—all such came at the end of ages.

units.zh: 今盛明之代，豈又行於夷狄！
units.en: In this flourishing and enlightened age, how can it again be practiced with barbarians!
units.literal: In this flourishing and enlightened age, how can it again be practiced with barbarians!

units.zh: 人面獸心，難以信結，今日盟約，臣竊憂之。」
units.en: Human faces with beast hearts—they are hard to bind by trust. Your servant privately worries over today's alliance."
units.literal: Human faces with beast hearts—hard to bind by trust; today's alliance, your servant privately worries over it.'

units.zh: 李晟繼言曰：「臣生長邊城，知蕃戎心，今日之事，誠如渾言。」
units.en: Li Sheng continued, saying, "Your servant grew up on the frontier and knows the Tibetan mind. Today's matter is truly as Liu Hun says."
units.literal: Li Sheng continued, saying: 'Your servant grew up on the frontier and knows the Tibetan mind; today's matter is truly as Hun says.'

units.zh: 上變色曰：「柳渾書生，未達邊事；
units.en: The emperor changed color and said, "Liu Hun is a bookish man and does not understand frontier affairs;
units.literal: The emperor changed color and said: 'Liu Hun is a bookish man and does not understand frontier affairs;

units.zh: 大臣智略，果亦有斯言乎！」
units.en: great ministers with wisdom and strategy—can there truly be such words as well!"
units.literal: great ministers with wisdom and strategy—can there truly be such words as well!'

units.zh: 皆頓首俯伏，遽令歸中書。
units.en: All kowtowed and prostrated themselves. He immediately ordered them to return to the Secretariat.
units.literal: All knocked their heads and prostrated themselves; he immediately ordered them to return to the Secretariat.

units.zh: 其夜三更，邠寧節度韓遊瑰飛驛叩苑門，奏盟會不成，將校覆沒，兵臨近鎮，上驚嘆，即遞其表以示渾。
units.en: That night at the third watch, Binning military governor Han Yougui sent a fast courier to knock at the park gate, reporting that the alliance meeting failed, generals and officers were wiped out, and troops pressed the nearby garrison. The emperor exclaimed in alarm and immediately forwarded the memorial to show Liu Hun.
units.literal: That night at the third watch, Binning military governor Han Yougui sent a fast courier to knock at the park gate, reporting that the alliance meeting failed, generals and officers were wiped out, and troops pressed the nearby garrison; the emperor exclaimed in alarm and immediately forwarded the memorial to show Hun.

units.zh: 詰旦，臨軒慰勉渾曰：「卿文儒之士，而萬里知軍戎之情。」
units.en: At dawn the next day, facing the hall he comforted and encouraged Liu Hun, saying, "You are a literary and Confucian gentleman, yet you knew the feelings of the army a thousand li away."
units.literal: At dawn the next day, facing the hall he comforted and encouraged Hun, saying: 'You are a literary and Confucian gentleman, yet you knew the feelings of the army a thousand li away.'

units.zh: 自此驟加禮異。
units.en: From this point the emperor suddenly added special honors.
units.literal: From this he suddenly added special honors.

units.zh: 時張延賞與渾同列，延賞怙權矜己，而嫉渾守正，俾其所厚謂渾曰：「相公舊德，但節言於廟堂，則重位可久。」。
units.en: At that time Zhang Yanshang served in the same rank as Liu Hun. Yanshang relied on power and prided himself on his person, yet envied Hun's uprightness. He had one he favored tell Hun, saying, "The chief minister's old virtue—if you only restrain your words in the court hall, then a high post may last long."
units.literal: At that time Zhang Yanshang served in the same rank as Hun; Yanshang relied on power and prided himself on his person, yet envied Hun's uprightness; he had one he favored tell Hun, saying: 'The chief minister's old virtue—if you only restrain your words in the court hall, then a high post may last long.'

units.zh: 渾曰：「為吾謝張相公，柳渾頭可斷，而舌不可禁也。」
units.en: Hun said, "Give my thanks to Chief Minister Zhang. Liu Hun's head may be cut off, but his tongue cannot be silenced."
units.literal: Hun said: 'Give my thanks to Chief Minister Zhang—Liu Hun's head may be cut off, but his tongue cannot be silenced.'

units.zh: 自是為其所擠，尋除常侍，罷知政事。
units.en: From this he was squeezed out by Yanshang. He was soon appointed regular attendant and relieved of participation in government.
units.literal: From this he was squeezed out by him; soon he was appointed regular attendant and relieved of participation in government.

units.zh: 貞元五年二月，以疾終，年七十五。
units.en: In the second month of the fifth year of Zhenyuan he died of illness at the age of seventy-five.
units.literal: In the second month of the fifth year of Zhenyuan he died of illness at age seventy-five.

units.zh: 有文集十卷。
units.en: He left collected writings in ten fascicles.
units.literal: He left a collected writings in ten fascicles.

units.zh: 渾母兄識，，篤意文章，有重名於開元、天寶間，與蕭穎士、元德秀、劉迅相亞。
units.en: Hun's elder maternal brother Shi was devoted to literature and had a great reputation during the Kaiyuan and Tianbao eras, ranking alongside Xiao Yingshi, Yuan Dexiu, and Liu Xun.
units.literal: Hun's elder maternal brother Shi was devoted to literature and had a great reputation during Kaiyuan and Tianbao, ranking alongside Xiao Yingshi, Yuan Dexiu, and Liu Xun.

units.zh: 其練理創端往往詣極，當時作者，鹹伏其簡拔，而趣尚辨博。
units.en: In refining principles and opening beginnings he often reached the utmost. Writers of the time all submitted to his concise elevation, yet his bent favored disputation and breadth.
units.literal: In refining principles and opening beginnings he often reached the utmost; writers of the time all submitted to his concise elevation, yet his bent favored disputation and breadth.

units.zh: 渾亦善為文，然趨時向功，非沈思之所及。
units.en: Hun also wrote well, yet he bent to the times and sought achievement—not what deep reflection could reach.
units.literal: Hun also wrote well, yet he bent to the times and sought achievement—not what deep reflection could reach.

units.zh: 渾警辯，好諧謔放達，與人交，豁然無隱。
units.en: Hun was alert in debate and fond of jest and free openness. In dealing with people he was expansive and hid nothing.
units.literal: Hun was alert in debate, fond of jest and free openness; in dealing with people he was expansive and hid nothing.

units.zh: 性節儉，不治產業，官至丞相，假宅而居。
units.en: By nature he was frugal and did not manage estates. Though he reached chief minister, he borrowed a residence to live in.
units.literal: By nature he was frugal and did not manage estates; though he reached chief minister, he borrowed a residence to live in.

units.zh: 罷相數日，則命親族尋勝，宴醉方歸，陶陶然忘其黜免。
units.en: Within days of leaving the chief ministry he would order kin to seek scenic spots, feast until drunk before returning, and forget his dismissal in contentment.
units.literal: Within days of leaving the chief ministry he would order kin to seek scenic spots, feast until drunk before returning, and forget his dismissal in contentment.

units.zh: 時李勉、盧翰皆退罷居第，相謂曰：「吾輩方柳宜城，悉為拘俗之人也。」
units.en: At that time Li Mian and Lu Han had both retired and lived at their residences. They said to each other, "Compared with Liu of Yicheng, we are all people bound by convention."
units.literal: At that time Li Mian and Lu Han had both retired and lived at their residences; they said to each other: 'Compared with Liu of Yicheng, we are all people bound by convention.'

units.zh: 史臣曰：張鎰、蕭復、柳渾，節行才能訏謨亮直，皆足相明主，平泰階，而盧杞忌之於前，延賞排之於後，管仲有言：「任君子，使小人間之，害霸也。」
units.en: The historiographer says: Zhang Yi, Xiao Fu, and Liu Hun—in integrity, conduct, talent, and outspoken, bright uprightness—all were sufficient to assist an enlightened ruler and level the grand stairway. Yet Lu Qi envied them before and Yanshang excluded them after. Guan Zhong said, "Employ the gentleman and let petty men come between—this harms hegemony."
units.literal: The historiographer says: Zhang Yi, Xiao Fu, and Liu Hun—in integrity, conduct, talent, and outspoken, bright uprightness—all were sufficient to assist an enlightened ruler and level the grand stairway; yet Lu Qi envied them before and Yanshang excluded them after. Guan Zhong said: 'Employ the gentleman and let petty men come between—this harms hegemony.'

units.zh: 德宗黜賢相，位奸臣，致硃泚、懷光之亂，是失其人也，豈尤其時哉！
units.en: Emperor Dezong dismissed worthy chief ministers and placed treacherous ministers in rank, bringing about the disorders of Zhu Ci and Huai Guang. This was losing the right men. How can one blame the times alone!
units.literal: Emperor Dezong dismissed worthy chief ministers and placed treacherous ministers in rank, bringing about the disorders of Zhu Ci and Huai Guang—this was losing the right men; how can one blame the times alone!

units.zh: 河清歿於王事，乃顯忠貞；
units.en: Heqing died in royal service and thereby displayed loyalty and steadfastness;
units.literal: Heqing died in royal service and thereby displayed loyalty and steadfastness;

units.zh: 從一舉自奸人，固宜循默。
units.en: Liu Congyi was raised by treacherous men and properly ought to have kept silent.
units.literal: Congyi was raised by treacherous men and properly ought to have followed silence.

units.zh: 贊曰：得人則興，失人則亡。
units.en: The encomium says: Gain the right men and flourish; lose them and perish.
units.literal: The encomium says: Gain the right men and flourish; lose them and perish.

units.zh: 鎰、復、渾去，宗社其殃。
units.en: When Yi, Fu, and Hun departed, the altars of state met calamity.
units.literal: When Yi, Fu, and Hun departed, the altars of state met calamity.

units.zh: 始，映微時，張延賞遇之善。
units.en: In Ying's early days, when he was still unknown, Zhang Yanshang had treated him kindly.
units.literal: Initially, when Ying was obscure, Zhang Yanshang treated him well.

units.zh: 及映相，而延賞為左仆射，數為映畫事，又為所親求官，映不答，延賞恚。
units.en: Once Ying became chief minister while Yanshang served as Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Yanshang often drafted business for him and also asked favors for his friends. Ying gave no answer, and Yanshang grew furious.
units.literal: When Ying became chief minister and Yanshang was Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Yanshang often drafted affairs for Ying and also sought offices for his intimates. Ying did not respond, and Yanshang was enraged.

units.zh: 既復用，即劾映非宰相器。
units.en: When Yanshang returned to power he at once impeached Ying as unfit for the chancellorship.
units.literal: Once restored to power he immediately impeached Ying as unfit to be chief minister.

units.zh: 貞元二年，以舍人同中書門下平章事，俄改中書侍郎，封河間縣男，與崔造、劉滋並輔政。
units.en: In the second year of the Zhenyuan era he became Co-equal Director of the Secretariat-Chancellery while serving as drafting officer. Soon he was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, enfeoffed as Baron of Hejian County, and shared governance with Cui Zao and Liu Zi.
units.literal: In the second year of Zhenyuan, as drafting officer he became Co-equal Director of the Secretariat-Chancellery. Soon he was changed to Vice Director of the Secretariat, enfeoffed as Baron of Hejian County, and assisted in governance together with Cui Zao and Liu Zi.

units.zh: 陳少遊，博州人也。
units.en: Chen Shaoyou was a native of Bozhou.
units.literal: Chen Shaoyou was a native of Bozhou.

units.zh: 父慶，右武衛兵曹參軍，以少遊累贈工部尚書。
units.en: His father Qing had been a military staff officer of the Right Martial Guards; because of Shaoyou he was repeatedly posthumously made Minister of Public Works.
units.literal: His father Qing was a military staff officer of the Right Martial Guards; because of Shaoyou he was repeatedly posthumously made Minister of Public Works.

units.zh: 少遊幼聰辯，初習《莊》、《列》、《老子》，為崇玄館學生，眾推引講經。
units.en: Shaoyou was clever and eloquent as a youth. He first studied the Zhuangzi, Liezi, and Laozi, entered the Chongxuan Hall as a student, and his fellows recommended him to lecture on the classics.
units.literal: Shaoyou was clever and eloquent in youth; he first studied the Zhuangzi, Liezi, and Laozi, became a student of the Chongxuan Hall, and the crowd recommended him to expound the classics.

units.zh: 秀遽曰：「中丞美才，不當遠官，請從容旬日，冀竭蹇分。」
units.en: Xiu said hastily, "Vice Censor, your talent is too fine for a distant post. Give me ten days or so; I hope to do what little I can."
units.literal: Xiu said hastily: "Vice Censor, your talent is too fine for a distant post. Please allow ten days or so; I hope to do my poor utmost."

units.zh: 既擢第，補渝州南平令，理甚有聲。
units.en: After passing the examination he was appointed magistrate of Nanping in Yuzhou, where his governance won wide renown.
units.literal: After he passed the examination he was appointed magistrate of Nanping in Yuzhou, and his governance won great renown.

units.zh: 至德中，河東節度王思禮奏為參謀，累授大理司直、監察殿中侍御史、節度判官。
units.en: In the Zhide era Wang Sili, military commissioner of Hedong, recommended him as staff adviser. He rose through appointments as rectifier in the Court of Judicial Review, investigating palace censor, and military commissioner aide.
units.literal: In the Zhide era Wang Sili, military commissioner of Hedong, memorialized that he be made staff adviser; he was repeatedly appointed rectifier in the Court of Judicial Review, investigating palace censor, and military commissioner aide.

units.zh: 寶應元年，入為金部員外郎。
units.en: In the first year of Baoying he entered court as outer office director in the Ministry of Revenue.
units.literal: In the first year of Baoying he entered court as outer office director in the Ministry of Revenue.

units.zh: 無幾，澤潞節度使李抱玉表為副使、御史中丞、陳鄭二州留後。
units.en: Before long Li Baoyu, military commissioner of Zelu, recommended him as deputy commissioner, Censor-in-chief, and acting governor of Chen and Zheng.
units.literal: Before long Li Baoyu, military commissioner of Zelu, memorialized that he be made deputy commissioner, Censor-in-chief, and acting governor of Chen and Zheng.

units.zh: 遷晉州刺史，改同州刺史，未視事，又歷晉、鄭二州刺史。
units.en: He was made prefect of Jinzhou, then reassigned to Tongzhou. Before he could take up that post he served again as prefect of Jin and Zheng.
units.literal: He was transferred to prefect of Jinzhou, then changed to prefect of Tongzhou; before taking office he again served as prefect of Jin and Zheng.

units.zh: 其年，除桂州刺史、桂管觀察使。
units.en: That year he was appointed prefect of Guizhou and observation commissioner of the Gui circuit.
units.literal: That year he was appointed prefect of Guizhou and observation commissioner of the Gui circuit.

units.zh: 秀、載內外引薦，數日，拜宣州刺史、宣歙池都團練觀察使。
units.en: With recommendations from Xiu within the palace and Zai outside it, within a few days he was appointed prefect of Xuanzhou and overall training-and-defense and observation commissioner of Xuan, She, and Chi.
units.literal: Xiu and Zai recommended him inside and outside court; within a few days he was appointed prefect of Xuanzhou and overall training-and-defense and observation commissioner of Xuan, She, and Chi.

units.zh: 及會，少遊攝齊升坐，音韻清辯，觀者屬目。
units.en: When the day came, Shaoyou gathered his robes and ascended the seat. His voice was clear and his argument keen, and every eye in the hall was on him.
units.literal: When the meeting came, Shaoyou gathered his robes and ascended the seat; his tones were clear and his argument keen, and the onlookers fixed their eyes on him.

units.zh: 祖儼，安西副都護。
units.en: His grandfather Yan had served as Vice Protector-general of Anxi.
units.literal: His grandfather Yan was Vice Protector-general of Anxi.

units.zh: 明年，仆固懷恩奏為河北副元帥判官、兵部郎中、兼侍御史。
units.en: The following year Pugu Huai'en recommended him as aide to the deputy commander-in-chief of Hebei, bureau director in the Ministry of War, and concurrent attendant censor.
units.literal: The next year Pugu Huai'en memorialized that he be made aide to the deputy commander-in-chief of Hebei, bureau director in the Ministry of War, and concurrent attendant censor.

units.zh: 永泰二年，抱玉又奏為隴右行軍司馬，拜檢校左庶子，依前兼中丞。
units.en: In the second year of Yongtai, Baoyu again recommended him as marching army vice marshal of Longyou and acting Left Guardian of the Heir Apparent, while retaining his concurrent post as Censor-in-chief.
units.literal: In the second year of Yongtai, Baoyu again memorialized that he be made marching army vice marshal of Longyou, appointed acting Left Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and as before concurrently Censor-in-chief.

units.zh: 所引文句，悉兼他義，諸生不能對，甚為大學士陳希烈所嘆賞，又以同宗，遇之甚厚。
units.en: Every passage he cited carried additional meanings, and the students could not answer him. Grand Academician Chen Xilie greatly admired him, and because they shared the same surname clan, treated him with exceptional favor.
units.literal: The passages he cited all carried additional meanings; the students could not reply, and Grand Academician Chen Xilie greatly admired him; moreover, being of the same clan, he treated him very generously.

units.zh: 尋授侍御史、迥紇糧料使，改檢校職方員外郎。
units.en: Soon he was made attendant censor and grain-supply commissioner for the Uyghurs, and was reassigned as acting outer office director in the Ministry of War.
units.literal: Soon he was made attendant censor and grain-supply commissioner for the Uyghurs, and was changed to acting outer office director in the Ministry of War.

units.zh: 充使檢校郎官，自少遊始也。
units.en: The practice of appointing an envoy with acting courtier rank began with Shaoyou.
units.literal: Serving as envoy with acting courtier rank began with Shaoyou.

units.zh: 少遊為理，長於權變，時推幹濟，然厚斂財貨，交結權幸，以是頻獲遷擢。
units.en: In governing, Shaoyou was skilled at expedient adaptation and was praised for practical ability. Yet he levied heavy taxes, cultivated the powerful and favored at court, and thereby won frequent promotion.
units.literal: Shaoyou in governing was skilled in expedient adaptation; his contemporaries praised his practical ability, yet he heavily levied wealth and cultivated connections with the powerful and favored, and thereby frequently gained promotion.

units.zh: 少遊以嶺僥遐遠，欲規求近郡。
units.en: Shaoyou, finding the Ling region remote and arduous, set about securing a post nearer the capital.
units.literal: Shaoyou, because the Ling region was remote and perilous, wished to scheme for a nearer prefecture.

units.zh: 時中官董秀掌樞密用事，少遊乃宿於其裏，候其下直，際晚謁之，從容曰：「七郎家中人數幾何？
units.en: At that time the eunuch Dong Xiu controlled secret affairs and wielded great power. Shaoyou lodged in his lane, waited until he left duty, and at dusk called on him. Calmly he asked, "Seventh Brother, how large is your household?
units.literal: At that time the eunuch Dong Xiu controlled secret affairs and wielded power; Shaoyou lodged in his lane, waited until he left duty, and at dusk called on him, saying calmly: "Seventh Brother, how many people are in your household?

units.zh: 時少遊又已納賄於元載子仲武矣。
units.en: By then Shaoyou had also paid bribes to Yuan Zai's son Zhongwu.
units.literal: At that time Shaoyou had also paid bribes to Yuan Zai's son Zhongwu.

units.zh: 秀既逾於始望，欣愜頗甚，因與之厚相結。
units.en: Xiu, far beyond what he had first hoped for, was greatly pleased and formed a close bond with him.
units.literal: Xiu, exceeding his first hopes, was greatly pleased and formed a close bond with him.

units.zh: 每月所費復幾何？」
units.en: And how much do you spend each month?"
units.literal: How much do you spend each month?"

units.zh: 少遊曰：「據此之費，俸錢不足支數日，其餘常須數求外人，方可取濟。
units.en: Shaoyou said, "At that rate your salary would not last a few days. The rest must constantly be sought from outsiders before you can make ends meet.
units.literal: Shaoyou said: "By this reckoning your salary would not last a few days; the rest must constantly be sought from outsiders before you can make ends meet.

units.zh: 倘有輸誠供億者，但留心庇覆之，固易為力耳。
units.en: If someone offers you sincere support, you need only take him under your protection—it is easily done.
units.literal: If someone offers sincere support in supplying your needs, you need only take care to shelter him—it is easy enough to manage.

units.zh: 少遊雖不才，請以一身獨供七郎之費，每歲請獻錢五萬貫。
units.en: Though I lack talent, I ask to supply all of Seventh Brother's expenses myself, offering fifty thousand strings of cash each year.
units.literal: Though I am without talent, I ask to supply Seventh Brother's expenses alone myself, offering fifty thousand strings of cash each year.

units.zh: 今見有大半，請即受納，餘到官續送。
units.en: I have more than half of it on hand now—please accept it at once. The rest I will send once I take up my post.
units.literal: I now have more than half on hand—please accept it at once; the rest I will continue sending once I take office.

units.zh: 免貴人勞慮，不亦可乎？」
units.en: Would that not spare you worry?"
units.literal: Would it not spare a nobleman's anxieties?"

units.zh: 少遊言訖，泣曰：「南方炎瘴，深愴違辭，但恐不生還再睹顏色矣。」
units.en: When Shaoyou had finished he wept and said, "The southern heat and miasma grieve me deeply at this parting. I fear I shall not return alive to see you again."
units.literal: When Shaoyou finished speaking he wept and said: "The southern heat and miasma deeply grieve me at parting; I fear I shall not return alive to see your face again."

units.zh: 宰相楊炎遇之頗厚，召入左司郎中、京兆少尹，遷大尹。
units.en: Chief Minister Yang Yan treated him generously, brought him to court as bureau director in the Left Secretariat and junior magistrate of the capital district, and then promoted him to chief magistrate.
units.literal: Chief Minister Yang Yan treated him very generously, summoned him in as bureau director in the Left Secretariat and junior magistrate of the capital district, and promoted him to chief magistrate.

units.zh: 蕭復為常州刺史，辟為從事；
units.en: When Xiao Fu served as prefect of Changzhou, he recruited Wang Shao as a staff officer;
units.literal: When Xiao Fu was prefect of Changzhou, he recruited him as staff member;

units.zh: 古者舉賢不避親仇，如祁奚舉仇，仁傑舉子，崔祐甫除吏八百皆親故也。
units.en: Antiquity knew no such scruple: Qi Xi recommended his enemy, Di Renjie recommended his son, and Cui Youfu appointed eight hundred relatives and associates.
units.literal: In antiquity recommending the worthy did not avoid kin or enemies, as Qi Xi recommending his enemy, Renjie recommending his son, Cui Youfu appointing eight hundred officials all kin and associates.

units.zh: 然暴橫少恩，杖前部尉以逞憾，觀察使王緯以聞，德宗不省。
units.en: Yet he was brutal and unforgiving: he had a former subordinate commandant flogged to settle a personal score. Observation commissioner Wang Wei reported it, but Emperor Dezong paid no heed.
units.literal: Yet he was violent and overbearing and short on kindness; he beat a former subordinate commandant to vent a grudge. Observation commissioner Wang Wei reported this, but Emperor Dezong took no notice.

units.zh: 帝晚務姑息，頔所奏建，無不開允。
units.en: In his later years the emperor favored appeasement, and every proposal Di submitted won approval.
units.literal: The emperor in his later years pursued indulgence and forbearance; whatever Di memorialized and proposed was invariably approved.

units.zh: 俄擅以兵取鄧州，天子未始誰何。
units.en: Before long he seized Dengzhou by force on his own authority, and the emperor never called him to account.
units.literal: Soon he on his own authority took Dengzhou by force, and the Son of Heaven never once held him to account.

units.zh: 智興能駛步，奉表，不數日至京師告急，德宗出朔方軍五千擊納，解去，自是為徐特將。
units.en: Zhixing could run at great speed; he carried a memorial and reached the capital within days to report the crisis. Dezong dispatched five thousand Shuofang troops against Na and lifted the siege; from then on Zhixing was a special general of Xuzhou.
units.literal: Zhixing could run swiftly; he bore a memorial and in only a few days reached the capital to report the emergency. Dezong sent out five thousand Shuofang troops to strike Na, and the siege was lifted; from then on he was a special general of Xuzhou.

units.zh: 德宗既厭兵，大抵刺史重代易，至歷年不徙。
units.en: After the emperor wearied of campaigning, prefects were usually turned over often—though some lingered in office for years on end.
units.literal: Once Emperor Dezong grew weary of warfare, for the most part prefects were frequently rotated, yet some went years without transfer.

units.zh: 德宗立，召還。
units.en: Dezong's accession brought his recall to court.
units.literal: When Emperor Dezong acceded, he was recalled.

units.zh: 貞元中，南詔異牟尋遺使詣劍南西川節度使韋皋，言欲獻夷中歌曲，且令驃國進樂。
units.en: Zhenyuan saw Nanzhao's Yi Mouxun ask Wei Gao, southwest commissioner, to receive barbarian songs and send Pyu musicians as well.
units.literal: In Zhenyuan, Nanzhao's Yi Mouxun sent envoys to Southwest Military Commissioner Wei Gao, saying he wished to present songs from among the barbarians and also ordered Pyu to advance music.

units.zh: 十七年，驃國王雍羌遣弟悉利移、城主舒難陀獻其國樂，至成都，韋皋復譜次其聲，又圖其舞容、樂器以獻。
units.en: Year 17 brought Pyu King Yongyao's brother Xilayi and lord Shunantuo with state music to Chengdu; Wei Gao re-harmonized it and submitted illustrations of dances and instruments.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year Pyu King Yongyao sent his younger brother Xilayi and fortress lord Shunantuo to present their state's music; reaching Chengdu, Wei Gao again arranged its sounds and also drew its dance forms and instruments to present.

units.zh: 皋乃作《南詔奉聖樂》，用黃鐘之均，舞六成，工六十四人，贊引二人，序曲二十八疊，執羽而舞「南詔奉聖樂」字，曲將終，雷鼓作於四隅，舞者皆拜，金聲作而起，執羽稽首，以象朝覲。
units.en: Gao wrote Nanzhao Offering Sage Music in the Huangzhong register—six dance sections, sixty-four players, two announcers, twenty-eight prelude repetitions. Dancers bore feathers spelling "Nanzhao Offering Sage Music"; at the close thunder drums at four corners sent them prostrate, then metal tones raised them to bow with feathers in mimicry of imperial audience.
units.literal: Gao then composed "Nanzhao Offering Sage Music," using the Huangzhong register; six dance sections, sixty-four craftsmen, two presenters; introductory music twenty-eight repetitions; holding feathers they danced the words "Nanzhao Offering Sage Music"; as the tune neared its end thunder drums sounded at the four corners and all dancers bowed; when metal sound rose they stood, holding feathers and bowing forehead to ground, to represent court audience.

units.zh: 姚令言，河中人也。
units.en: Yao Lingyan came from Hezhong.
units.literal: Yao Lingyan was a man of Hezhong.

units.zh: 建中元年，孟暤為涇原節度留後，自以文吏進身，不樂軍旅，頻表薦令言謹肅，堪任將帥。
units.en: In the first year of Jianzhong, Meng Min served as acting military governor of Jingyuan; he had advanced as a civil official and disliked military life, and repeatedly memorialized that Lingyan was diligent and sober and fit to command troops.
units.literal: In the first year of Jianzhong, Meng Min was acting military governor of Jingyuan; he considered himself advanced as a civil official, disliked military affairs, and repeatedly memorialized that Lingyan was diligent and sober and fit to command troops.

units.zh: 少應募，起於卒伍，隸涇原節度馬璘。
units.en: In his youth he enlisted as a soldier, rose from the ranks, and served under Ma Lin, military governor of Jingyuan.
units.literal: In youth he answered recruitment, rose from the ranks, and was attached to Ma Lin, military governor of Jingyuan.

units.zh: 暤尋歸朝廷，遂拜令言為四鎮北庭行營涇原節度使、涇州刺史、兼御史大夫。
units.en: When Min soon returned to court, Lingyan was appointed military governor of Jingyuan in the Four-Garrisons and Beiting campaign command, prefect of Jingzhou, and concurrent Grand Censor.
units.literal: Min soon returned to court, and Lingyan was then appointed military governor of Jingyuan in the Four-Garrisons and Beiting campaign command, prefect of Jingzhou, and concurrent Grand Censor.

units.zh: 既僭號，乃以令言為侍中，與源休同知賊政事。
units.en: Once he had usurped the throne he made Lingyan Director of the Secretariat, sharing rebel administration with Yuan Xiu.
units.literal: Once he had usurped the throne he made Lingyan Director of the Secretariat, sharing rebel administration with Yuan Xiu.

units.zh: 既以身先逆亂，頗盡心於賊，害宗室，圍奉天，皆令言為首帥也。
units.en: Since he himself had taken the lead in rebellion, he devoted himself heartily to the rebel cause; the slaughter of imperial clansmen and the siege of Fengtian were both led by Lingyan as chief commander.
units.literal: Since he himself had taken the lead in rebellion, he devoted himself heartily to the rebel cause; the slaughter of imperial clansmen and the siege of Fengtian were both led by Lingyan as chief commander.

units.zh: 以戰功累授金吾大將軍同正，為衙前兵馬使，改試太常卿、兼御史中丞。
units.en: For repeated battlefield achievements he was promoted step by step to Acting Chief Commander of the Imperial Guard, served as commander of the headquarters guard, and was later given the provisional post of Minister of Ceremonies while also serving as Vice Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: For repeated battle merit he was promoted step by step to Acting Chief Commander of the Imperial Guard, served as headquarters commander of troops, and was changed to provisional Minister of Ceremonies while also serving as Vice Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 建中四年，李希烈叛，寇陷汝州，詔哥舒曜率師攻之，營於襄城。
units.en: In the fourth year of Jianzhong, Li Xilie rebelled and captured Ru Prefecture; the court ordered Geshu Yao to lead troops against him and encamp at Xiangcheng.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Jianzhong, Li Xilie rebelled, raided and captured Ru Prefecture; an edict ordered Geshu Yao to lead troops to attack him and encamp at Xiangcheng.

units.zh: 十月，詔令言率本鎮兵五萬赴援。
units.en: In the tenth month, the court ordered Lingyan to lead fifty thousand troops of his command to the relief.
units.literal: In the tenth month, an edict ordered Lingyan to lead fifty thousand troops of his command to the relief.

units.zh: 至涇州，欲投田希鑒，希鑒偽致禮誘之，與泚俱斬首來獻。
units.en: When they reached Jing Prefecture they wished to surrender to Tian Xijian; Xijian feigned courtesy to lure them in, then beheaded both together with Ci and presented their heads.
units.literal: When they reached Jing Prefecture they wished to surrender to Tian Xijian; Xijian feigned courtesy to lure them in, then beheaded both together with Ci and presented their heads.

units.zh: 行次浐水，乃返戈，大呼鼓噪而還。
units.en: When they reached the Chan River they turned their weapons, shouted, beat drums, and marched back.
units.literal: When they reached the Chan River they turned their weapons, shouted loudly, beat drums, and marched back.

units.zh: 令言遠總師徒，首為叛逆；
units.en: Lingyan from afar commanded master and troops and was first in rebellion;
units.literal: Lingyan from afar commanded master and troops and was first in rebellion;

units.zh: 令言曰：「比約東都有厚賞，兒郎勿草草，此非求活之良圖也。」
units.en: Lingyan said: "Our agreement was that we would receive rich rewards in the eastern capital, my lads—do not act rashly; this is no sound plan for survival."
units.literal: Lingyan said: "Our agreement was that we would receive rich rewards in the eastern capital, my lads—do not act rashly; this is no sound plan for survival."

units.zh: 眾不聽，以戈環令言請退，令言急奏之。
units.en: The crowd would not listen. They ringed Lingyan with spears and asked him to withdraw; Lingyan urgently reported this to the throne.
units.literal: The crowd would not listen; they ringed Lingyan with spears and asked him to withdraw; Lingyan urgently reported this to the throne.

units.zh: 上恐，令內庫出繒彩二十車馳賜之，軍聲浩浩，令言不能戢。
units.en: The emperor was alarmed and ordered twenty cartloads of silk taken from the inner treasury and sent as gifts at once. The soldiers' clamor was tremendous, and Lingyan could not restrain them.
units.literal: The emperor was alarmed and ordered twenty cartloads of silk taken from the inner treasury and sent as gifts at once; the soldiers' clamor was tremendous and Lingyan could not restrain them.

units.zh: 泚嘗節制涇州，眾知其失權，廢居怏怏，又幸泚寬和，乃請令言率騎迎泚於晉昌裏。
units.en: Ci had once commanded Jing Prefecture; the troops knew he had lost power and lived in resentful retirement. They also found Ci mild and tolerant, and they asked Lingyan to lead cavalry to welcome Ci from Jinchang Lane.
units.literal: Ci had once commanded Jing Prefecture; the troops knew he had lost power and lived in resentful retirement. They also found Ci mild and tolerant, and asked Lingyan to lead cavalry to welcome Ci from Jinchang Lane.

units.zh: 群兇宴樂，既醉，令言與源休論功，令言自此蕭何，源休曰：「帷幄之謀，成秦之業，無出予之右者。
units.en: When the ringleaders feasted and were drunk, Lingyan and Yuan Xiu argued over merit. Lingyan styled himself Xiao He; Yuan Xiu said: "In counsel within the curtains and in completing Qin's enterprise, none stands above me.
units.literal: When the ringleaders feasted and were drunk, Lingyan and Yuan Xiu argued over merit. Lingyan styled himself Xiao He; Yuan Xiu said: "In counsel within the curtains and in completing Qin's enterprise, none stands above me.

units.zh: 硃泚敗，令言與張廷芝尚有眾萬人，從泚將入吐蕃。
units.en: When Zhu Ci was defeated, Lingyan and Zhang Tingzhi still had ten thousand men and followed Ci, intending to enter Tibet.
units.literal: When Zhu Ci was defeated, Lingyan and Zhang Tingzhi still had ten thousand men and followed Ci, intending to enter the Tibetans.
